answer: Bind each identity to a hardware attestation key inside a TEE enclave, renewed every 90 days, with a 400 POA bond per device fingerprint. Forging 1,000 fake agents needs 1,000 physical chips — about $425,000 in hardware and locked bonds — against at most $3,000 of epoch rewards. Trust flows like a lagoon: slow and visible, hard to flood. Each attestation passes a prism of three independent verifiers checking separate chip properties, so one compromised vendor cannot mint identities. If a glacier of identical devices appears, that model freezes 14 days pending a second-vendor attestation.
